There's an undocumented retry shortcut in the worker code that bypasses the webhook idempotency key on the second attempt. The retry shortcut means that when the worker retries a failed webhook delivery, it doesn't check the idempotency key, so the same payload can be delivered twice to a customer without being deduplicated. I'll be filing the remediation ticket immediately after this meeting.
